lines.t: He spoke all into existence,
Everything according to His plan,
From the gentle ant’s persistence,
To the mighty trees that stand.
He formed man from the dust
Of the earth, He knew me
Before my birth.
All creation He spoke into being.
From every blade of grass,
To every mighty tree.
Yahuwah caused it to be.
(Chorus)
He created it all.
All that I see.
He caused it to be.
Mountains rose at His command,
He made the firmament on which
We stand. Everything, crafted by His hand.
Every living thing He spoke into being.
From the birds of the air,
To the fish deep in the sea.
He caused it all to be.
(Verse 2)
Every flower, He caused to bloom.
He brought forth life from the gloom.
Every hill, every valley,
The earth began to rally.
From the beautiful plants,
To the volcano that spews it's
Fervent heat, He caused all to meet.
All creation He spoke into being.
From every blade of grass,
To every mighty tree.
Yahuwah caused it to be.
(Chorus)
He created it all.
All that I see.
He caused it to be.
Mountains rose at His command,
He made the firmament on which
We stand. Everything, crafted by His hand.
Every living thing He spoke into being.
From the birds of the air,
To the fish deep in the sea.
He caused it all to be.
(Final)
In His image, we are wonderfully made,
A beautiful truth that will never fade.
With purpose and breath, He fashioned our frame.
From the stars above to the ocean's vast deep,
He caused it all to be.
